paite: Huan Ephraimte'n akiang ah, a hon "Bangziak a hichibang bawl e, Midiante na douna ua na hon chial sam louh?" achi uhi. Huchi in nakpitak in amah atai uhi.
heading: Midiante Zohna Nanung
english: The men of Ephraim said to him, “Why have you treated us this way, that you didn’t call us when you went to fight with Midian?” They rebuked him sharply.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou toh genkak ding ke'n bang ka hihzou a eita? Abiezerte grep loh sang a Ephraimte grep loh hoihzaw hilou maw?
english: He said to them, “What have I now done in comparison with you? Isn’t the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?

paite: Pathian in Midiante kumpipa Oreb leh Zeeb na khut uah ahon peta hi. Huchi in nou toh genkak ding in ke'n bang ka hihzou a eita?" achi hi. Huchi in huai thu agentak in atung a ahehna uh adaita hi.
english: God has delivered into your hand the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb! What was I able to do in comparison with you?” Then their anger was abated toward him when he had said that.

paite: Gideon leh akiang a om mi zathumte'n Jordan lui aphasuk ua, akan ua, bah mah le uh adelh teitei uhi.
english: Gideon came to the Jordan and passed over, he and the three hundred men who were with him, faint, yet pursuing.

paite: Sukoth a mite kiang ah, "Hehpih in kei hon zuite sangpek pe dih ua; abah mahmahta uh. Midiante kumpipa Zebah leh Zalmunna delh ka hi,” achi hi.
english: He said to the men of Succoth, “Please give loaves of bread to the people who follow me; for they are faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”

paite: Sukoth a miliante'n, “Zebah leh Zalmunna na khut a om khinta uhia, huchi a na sepaihte tanghou ka piak pah mai ding uh?" achi uh.
english: The princes of Succoth said, “Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your army?”

paite: Gideon in hiai ziak in, "TOUPA'N Zebah leh Zalmunna ka khut a ahon piak chiang in gamdai a ling leh louling neite in na sa uh ka kuikek ding," achi hi.
english: Gideon said, “Therefore when Yahweh has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.”

paite: Huai a pan Penuel ah ahohtou ua, akiang uah huchi mah bang in agen nawn hi. Penuel a mite'n Sukoth a mite dawn mah bang in adawng uhi.
english: He went up there to Penuel, and spoke to them in the same way; and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered.

paite: Penuel khomite kiang ah, "Vualzou a ka hong kik nawn chiang in, hiai kulh ka hihchim ding," achi hi.
english: He spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, “When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.”

paite: Zebah leh Zalmunna bel Karkor ah a-om ua, asepaihte leh suahlam mite sepaih asibang teng, singkhat-le-sangnga toh; namsau dok mi nuaikhat-le-singnih lah asi khinta ngal ua.
english: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand men, all who were left of all the army of the children of the east; for there fell one hundred twenty thousand men who drew sword.

paite: Gideon bel Nob leh Jogbeh suahlam a puanin a tengte lampi ah ahohtou a, sepaihte ava dou a; sepaihte galmuangtak in ana om ngal uhi.
english: Gideon went up by the way of those who lived in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and struck the army; for the army felt secure.

paite: Zebah leh Zalmunna ataikekta ua; amau adelh ua; huchi in Midiante kumpipa nih Zebah leh Zalmunna aman ua, sepaihte tengteng apatausakgawp uhi.
english: Zebah and Zalmunna fled and he pursued them. He took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and confused all the army.

paite: Joash tapa Gideon bel kidouna a pan nisuah ma in ahong kik nawnta hi.
english: Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle from the ascent of Heres.

paite: Sukoth ah tangval khat aman ua, thu adong ua; huchi in Sukoth a miliante leh upate min agelhsak vek a, sawmsagih-le-sagih ahi uh.
english: He caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and inquired of him; and he described for him the princes of Succoth, and its elders, seventy-seven men.

paite: Sukoth a mite kiang ah ahohtou a, "Zebah leh Zalmunna en dih ve ua, hiaite akei ua, Zebah leh Zalmunna na khut ua omsa bang a, mibahte tanghou ka piak ding uh, chi a na hon enghou uh?" achi hi.
english: He came to the men of Succoth, and said, “See Zebah and Zalmunna, concerning whom you taunted me, saying, ‘Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your men who are weary?’”

paite: Huchi in huai khua upate aman a, gamdai ling leh louling neite in Sukoth mite athuhilh hi.
english: He took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.

paite: Penuel khokulh ahihchim a, khua a mite leng athat hi.
english: He broke down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city.

paite: Huchi in Zebah leh Zalmunna kiang ah, "Tabor tang a na mithahte uh mi bangchibang ahi ua? achi hi. Amau, Nangmah bang ahi uh; Kumpipa tapate abang chiat uh,” achi uhi.
english: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, “What kind of men were they whom you killed at Tabor?” They answered, “They were like you. They all resembled the children of a king.”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka unaute ahi uh, ka nu tapate mahmah ahi ve ua. TOUPA ahin bang in, amaute na hinghawi le uchin zaw, nou hon that lou mah ding hi veng in," achi hi.
english: He said, “They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As Yahweh lives, if you had saved them alive, I would not kill you.”

paite: Atapa upapen Jether kiang ah, "Khai le, nang amaute that in," achi hi. Himahleh tangval in anamsau aphawi kei; tangval lel ahih lai ziak in alau hi.
english: He said to Jether his firstborn, “Get up and kill them!” But the youth didn’t draw his sword; for he was afraid, because he was yet a youth.

paite: Huchi in Zebah leh Zalmunna in, "Nangmah hong kisa in, hong satlum tanla. Piching leh piching kisual ding ahi," achi uhi. Huchi in Gideon athou a, Zebah leh Zalmunna that in, sangawngsaute ngawng zepnate ala hi.
english: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, “You rise and fall on us; for as the man is, so is his strength.” Gideon arose, and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the crescents that were on their camels’ necks.

paite: Huchi in Israel mite'n Gideon kiang ah, "Nang ka tung uah vaihawm in, nang leh na tapa leh na tapa tapate tan in leng; nang Midiante a pan lah na hon hunkheta ngal a," achi uhi.
english: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, “Rule over us, both you, your son, and your son’s son also; for you have saved us out of the hand of Midian.”

paite: Gideon in akiang uah, "Ke'n zaw na tung uah vai ka hawm kei ding. Ka tapa in leng na tung uah vai ahawm sam kei ding. TOUPA'N na tung uah vai ahawm zaw ding," achi hi.
english: Gideon said to them, “I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you. Yahweh shall rule over you.”

paite: Gideon in akiang uah, "Thil khat ahihleh hon nget ka ut, michih in na gallak bilbah uh hon pe chiat un," achi hi. (Ishmaelte ahih ziak un dangka-eng bilbah anei uhi).
english: Gideon said to them, “I do have a request: that you would each give me the earrings of his plunder.” (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)

paite: Amau, "Phaltak in ka hon pe ding uh," achi uhi. Huchi in puan aphah ua, michih in agallak bilbah uh apaikhe chiat uhi.
english: They answered, “We will willingly give them.” They spread a garment, and every man threw the earrings of his plunder into it.

paite: Huai dangka-eng bilbah angette gikdan dangka-eng shekel sangkhat-le-zasagih ahi; hakkolte, bilbahte, Midian kumpipate puan sandup sim louh in, asangawngsaute uh khainiang omte leng tel lou in.
english: The weight of the golden earrings that he requested was one thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold, in addition to the crescents, and the pendants, and the purple clothing that was on the kings of Midian, and in addition to the chains that were about their camels’ necks.

paite: Gideon in huaite in Ephod abawl a, a-omna Ophrah ah akoih hi. Israel tengteng in hiai thil ah ang a kawm uh. Huchi in Gideon leh a-inkote a ding in thang ahong hita hi.
english: Gideon made an ephod out of it, and put it in Ophrah, his city. Then all Israel played the prostitute with it there; and it became a snare to Gideon and to his house.

paite: Huchi in Midiante bel Israel suante nuaisiah in a-om ua; atangkhe zou nawn kei uhi. Huchi in Gideon damsung kum sawmli sung in gam galmuang in a-omta hi.
english: So Midian was subdued before the children of Israel, and they lifted up their heads no more. The land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon.

paite: Joash tapa Jerubbaal apai a, a-inn ah atengta hi.
heading: Gideon Sihna
english: Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and lived in his own house.

paite: Gideon in zi tampi aneih ziak in ama suan mahmah tapa sawmsagih anei hi.
english: Gideon had seventy sons conceived from his body, for he had many wives.

paite: Shekem a amei in tapa asuansak lai a, amin Abimelek asa hi.
english: His concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.

paite: Joash tapa Gideon kha leh khuk tuah a dam in asita a, Abiezer mi Ophrah a apa Joash han ah avui uhi.
english: Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Gideon asih phet in Israel suante akinunghei ua, Baalte toh ang a kawm ua, pathian in Baal-berith aneita uhi.
english: As soon as Gideon was dead, the children of Israel turned again and played the prostitute following the Baals, and made Baal Berith their god.

paite: Israel suante'n akim ua melmate tengteng lak a pan amau hunkhepa TOUPA a Pathian uh atheigige kei uhi.
english: The children of Israel didn’t remember Yahweh their God, who had delivered them out of the hand of all their enemies on every side;

paite: Jerubbaal, Gideon kichi mah, Israelte tung a theihtawp a hoih suahpa inkote leng ahehpih kei uhi.
english: neither did they show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shown to Israel.
